children: North Macedonia’s retail sales advanced by 5.6% year-on-year in July 2026, rebounding from a 1.0% drop in the previous month.

Activity strengthened in non-food products excluding fuel, jumping by 6.7% from 1.4%, and automotive fuel, rising by 13.2% from 2.5%, while trade in food, beverages, and tobacco was flat after falling by 4.2% in June.
Moreover, retail trade excluding automotive fuel rebounded sharply, rising by 3.6% from a 1.1% drop.

title: North Macedonia Retail Sales Rebound in July
